name: Barbell thruster
cue: Front squat straight into a push press, one movement; bar finishes locked out overhead.

name: Clean and jerk
cue: Pull the bar to the shoulders, stand, then dip and drive it overhead to lockout. Power clean and push jerk is fine.

name: Squat clean
cue: Pull, then drop under and receive the bar in a full front squat, stand it up.

name: Hang power clean
cue: From above the knee, extend the hips hard and catch the bar on the shoulders in a quarter squat.

name: Snatch
cue: Wide grip, bar from floor to overhead in one movement; squat or power, lock it out and stand.

name: Power snatch
cue: Wide grip, pull from the floor and punch the bar overhead, receiving above parallel.

name: Hang power snatch
cue: From above the knee, wide grip, extend and punch the bar overhead, catching above parallel.

name: Push press
cue: Bar on the shoulders, shallow dip, drive with the legs and press to lockout overhead.

name: Sumo deadlift high pull
cue: Wide stance, narrow grip, stand fast and pull the bar to the chin, elbows high.

name: Overhead squat
cue: Bar locked out overhead with a wide grip, squat below parallel keeping the bar over mid-foot.

name: Dumbbell snatch
cue: One dumbbell from the floor to overhead in one pull, lock out, switch hands each rep.

name: Wall ball
cue: Squat with the ball at the chest, drive up and throw to the target, catch and drop straight into the next rep.

name: Muscle-up
cue: Pull high on rings or bar, transition the chest over the hands, press out to lockout.

name: Ring dip
cue: Support on the rings, lower until the shoulders dip below the elbows, press back to lockout with rings turned out.

name: Handstand push-up
cue: Kick up against the wall, lower the head to the floor, press back to lockout. Kipping is fine.

name: Handstand
cue: Kick up into a handstand, hold briefly, come down under control.

name: Pistol (single-leg squat)
cue: One leg out in front, squat all the way down on the other, stand without touching down. Alternate legs.

name: Double-unders
cue: Rope passes twice under the feet per jump; jump a little higher, spin from the wrists.

name: Chest-to-bar pull-up
cue: Pull until the chest touches the bar below the collarbone, full lockout at the bottom.

name: Burpee over the bar
cue: Burpee facing the bar, chest to the floor, then jump over the bar with two feet and turn around.
